clips.tags: Energetic tech-showcase electronic instrumental at 124 BPM, punchy four-on-the-floor kick and crisp syncopated percussion, deep pulsing synth bass, glitchy futuristic arpeggios, cyberpunk edge with dark-fantasy tonal color. Confident high-impact production for an AI coding and game-development demo: open with a lean, voiceover-friendly groove, add rising filtered textures and short tension builds, hit impactful drops with broad synth stabs and tight low end, then alternate energetic sections with uncluttered pockets that leave the midrange clear for speech. Polished, precise, modern mix; decisive ending.
clips.title: Cyberpunk Edge
